annotations.title: Ask a verified business for a quote

description: Ask a verified business for a quote on an item it lists as price on request (price_on_request: true in list_business_offerings): a roofer, a lawyer, a garage. The request is emailed to the business, which replies to the customer with its price. Nothing is paid or owed and no wallet is needed. Ask the customer first and send consent: true only if they agreed that their name, contact and request go to the business. Returns a reference and a status URL.

consent.description: True only if the customer agreed that their name, contact and request are sent to the business

details.description: What the job is, in the customer's words

email.description: Where the business replies. Give email or phone, at least one

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when retrying

item.description: The service name exactly as listed

item_id.description: The item id from the catalogue

phone.description: Where the business replies. Give email or phone, at least one

photo_url.description: An https link to a photo the customer shared, if any

postal_code.description: Where the work is, or the customer's postal code

timing.description: When the customer wants it done, e.g. "within two weeks" or "flexible"

name: request_quote
title: Ask a verified business for a quote
